label: Organizational Restructuring Advisor
description: Analyzes proposed organizational restructuring options. Evaluates span of control, decision rights, role clarity, culture fit, and implementation risk.

guidedInputs.label: Current organisational structure
guidedInputs.description: Describe the current structure: reporting lines, team sizes, key roles, and known pain points.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Current: Chief Compliance Officer manages 3 direct reports (Head of AML, Head of Conduct Compliance, Head of Regulatory Affairs). Total team: 28 FTE. Pain points: AML and Conduct teams work in silos; Regulatory Affairs is overloaded; no dedicated second-line risk oversight for new product launches.

guidedInputs.label: Proposed restructuring options
guidedInputs.description: Describe the options being considered. If multiple options, number them clearly.
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Option 1: Merge AML and Conduct Compliance under a single Head of Financial Crime & Conduct, create new Head of Policy & Regulatory Affairs role.
Option 2: Create a new Product Compliance function reporting to CCO, with dotted line from each business unit compliance partner.
Option 3: Centralise all second-line functions under a new CRO position (currently no standalone CRO exists).

guidedInputs.label: Business context and strategic drivers
guidedInputs.description: What is driving the restructuring? Growth, cost reduction, regulatory requirement, leadership change?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Institution is preparing for AMLA implementation and anticipates significantly increased regulatory burden. Current structure was designed for a smaller organisation and has not kept pace with growth from 500 to 1,200 employees over 5 years.
